# onepassword_vault (Data Source)

Retrieves a 1Password vault by its ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Vault ID.

### Read-Only

- `active_item_count` (Number) Number of active items in the vault.
- `attribute_version` (Number) Vault attribute version.
- `content_version` (Number) Vault content version.
- `description` (String) Vault description.
- `title` (String) Vault title.
- `vault_type` (String) Vault type, e.g. `personal`.
